cases.title: The Vanishing Time Marker
cases.disaster: A student writes: I have visited Da Nang yesterday.
cases.safe_zone: Use simple past with finished time: I visited Da Nang yesterday.
cases.filing_note: Finished time markers push the verb phrase into simple past.
cases.student_task: Identify the clue that makes the sentence unsafe and rewrite it.

teacher_only.rationale: The adverb yesterday conflicts with present perfect usage.

student_challenges.prompt: Repair: She has met him last week.

teacher_only.rationale: Students often memorize tense names instead of checking time clues.

lesson: Lead with the broken sentence as evidence.
